Question: In perfect competition short-run equilibrium output, AR < SAC (average total cost? SAC likely short-run average cost) but > AVC (average variable cost). Then firm ____
Options:
A. 亏损，立即停产
B. 亏损，但应继续生产
C. 亏损，生产或不生产都可以
D. 获得正常利润，继续生产

Perfect competition: AR = price. If P < ATC (SAC) => economic loss. If P > AVC, firm should continue producing in short run to cover some fixed costs. If P = AVC shutdown point. If P < AVC shutdown. So B.

Need provide maybe concise explanation? User asks select correct. Final line format. Ensure last line exactly 答案：B. We can include explanation in Chinese. Need not overdo.
content:
在完全竞争市场中，AR = 价格 P。

若 AR < SAC，说明价格低于短期平均成本，厂商总收益不能覆盖全部成本，因此会亏损。  
但 AR > AVC，说明价格仍能覆盖平均可变成本，继续生产可以减少部分固定成本损失，所以短期应继续生产。

答案：B
